title: Eligibility and deadline checker
objective: Evaluate only explicitly configured, reviewed rules. Never infer eligibility from absent criteria.
guardrails: Rules are optional fields for education level, state, age range and income ceiling
exitCriteria: Unit/API tests cover matching, mismatch, missing fields and unconfigured rules. UI states this is not an official decision.
prototypeBoundary: This phase uses the Phase 09–17 prototype contracts. Database persistence and production auth are not claimed.
